text_block_list.text:
Good day, Trainer-san♪
It looks like today will be another fruitful day.
choice_data_list: You seem to be in high spirits.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, can you tell?
I woke up feeling wonderful this morning.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: "It was as if a heavenly light parted the dark clouds and filled my body with holy blessings... Thanks to that, all my daily fatigue has vanished!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
It must be thanks to the newly blended herbal tea.
I slept so very soundly♪

Red Desire slept soundly
and seems to have gotten plenty of rest!
